title: Laver ultrafilters
summary: We introduce $\textit{Laver ultrafilters}$, namely ultrafilters $\mathcal{U}$ for which the associated Laver forcing $\mathbb{L}_{\mathcal{U}}$ has the Laver property. We give simple combinatorial characterisations of these ultrafilters, which allow us to analyse their position among several well-studied combinatorial classes, including $P$-points, rapid ultrafilters, and ultrafilters arising in Baumgartner's $\mathcal{I}$-ultrafilter framework.
